text: Every cable, of what thickness forever it be, is com-poded of three friends, every friend of three ropes; and every rope of three twiffs - the twill is made of more or leds thread, according as the cable is to bo thicker or thinner.

parsed.faithful: Every cable, of what thickness foever it be, is com-posed of three ftrands; every ftrand of three ropes; and every rope of three twifts: the twift is made of more or lefs threads, according as the cable is to be thicker or thinner.
parsed.modern: Every cable, of what thickness soever it be, is composed of three strands; every strand of three ropes; and every rope of three twists: the twist is made of more or less threads, according as the cable is to be thicker or thinner.
